name: Deepfire Surge
description: Draw the deep fire up through the user in a surge that scorches a wide front.

name: Basalt Colossus
description: Raise a giant of black stone around the user that guards the body and strikes with fists of molten rock.

name: Glowing Deluge
description: Pour glowing liquid stone over the whole front in a slow irresistible flood.

name: Slag Mantle
description: Drape thick slag over the foe from head to foot and cool it into a crushing mantle.

name: Worldfire Lance
description: Spear a lance of the world's deep fire through the strongest ward and the body behind it.

name: Obsidian Firmament
description: Spread a black glass sky overhead that turns aside all force that falls from above.

name: Molten Awakening
description: Wake the fire at the core fully and let it raise the strength of every blow the user throws.

name: Magma Sovereignty
description: Make the whole field answer to the user's heat and slow every foe that stands on it.

name: Heartfire Edict
description: Decree the heartfire over the field at a reach and weight that scale with the user's reserve.

name: Stone Crown
description: Crown the user in a stone heart that wards the body and bursts out in a measure set by the core.

name: Rending Eruption
description: Burst the earth open in a rending eruption that melts an entire battlefield to the ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Unquenched Core
description: Burn with the fire at the heart of the world so that stone and steel in range stay molten and cannot be set again.
